answer.action: Authorised Dealer Category-I banks may facilitate the new US Dollar-Rupee Forex Swap Facility for eligible External Commercial Borrowings and Overseas Foreign Currency Borrowings.
answer.action_quote: Eligible banks can approach the Financial Markets Operations Department by e- mail with their request for US Doll ar Swap Facility indicating the amount of US Dollars to be swapped, tenor of the swap along with the declaration

effective_date.quote: The Swap Facility comes into effect from the date of this circular
